issues.detail: The Hebrew text does not mention '人從城中上來' (people coming up from the city). The Hebrew says 'וְהָאִישׁ מִהַר וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לְעֵלִי' — 'and the man hurried and came and told Eli.' The Chinese adds '從城中上來' (came up from the city), which is not in the Hebrew. This is an addition of a location detail not present in the source.
